name: Image compressor
description: Make photos and images smaller without uploading them. Choose a quality and size, and see the new file size before you download.

seo.metaTitle: Image compressor — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Make photos and images smaller without uploading them. Choose a quality and size, and see the new file size before you download. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/image-compress-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Image compressor processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/image-compress-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Image compressor upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Image compressor executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/image-compress-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Image compressor?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/image_compress.json or open /tools/image-compress?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
